address: No. 20, Ganjia Village, Liaoyuan Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: Nice little holiday villa with a swimming pool at the back. The room has a kettle and bottles of water, but no tea or coffee. There’s not too much around the hotel, but it is just a 20 minute walk...

comments.quote: I chose this place when I visited Moganshan during the May Day holiday. It's close to Yucun Square, and because it's not on the main street, the room is very quiet, which ensures a good rest.
